question: Assume today is 2026-10-24. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total profits of China's industrial enterprises above designated size (规模以上工业企业利润总额) for January-September 2026 (the cumulative total, not the single month of September), in Chinese yuan (CNY; the release states it in 亿元, i.e. units of 100 million yuan), as it will be first reported in the National Bureau of Statistics of China's monthly release on profits of industrial enterprises.

target.what: Cumulative total profits of China's industrial enterprises above designated size (规模以上工业企业利润总额), January-September 2026, as first reported by NBS in its monthly profits release
target.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
target.caveats: Target period ends 2026-09-30, before the 2026-10-24 cutoff, but the first release typically appears around 2026-10-27, i.e. after cutoff, so the exact figure is unavailable. 'Above designated size' means annual main business revenue ≥ 20 million CNY (threshold changed over time); coverage is enterp

candidates.perspective: NBS monthly profits release time series
candidates.hypothesis: Jan-Sep 2026 cumulative profit = Jan-Aug 2026 cumulative (published ~late Sep 2026, before cutoff) plus September single-month profit; September single-month can be inferred from seasonal share of September in prior years' Jan-Sep totals, or from the Jan-Sep vs Jan-Aug difference in prior years. Own history gives the base level and seasonal increment.
candidates.data_to_find: NBS cumulative 利润总额 for Jan-Aug 2026 (亿元) and same-period values for 2023, 2024, 2025; monthly single-month September profits for 2023-2025; the historical September share of Jan-Sep cumulative. Minimum: Jan-Aug 2026 cumulative and 3 years of September increments.

assessment.note: All restate the same NBS Jan-Aug 2026 release: total profit 52,719.8亿元, +15.7% yoy, revenue 93.09万亿元 +6.6%, margin 5.66% (+0.44pp). Multiple URLs but one underlying measurement; treat as a single anchor, not independent confirmation.
All report August 2026 single-month profit growth of +4.2% (prior month +11.2%). Same NBS figure repeated; one measurement.

Sector split of the same Jan-Aug 2026 release: mining 7,661.5亿元 +35.1%, manufacturing 39,695.3亿元 +17.4%, utilities 5,363.0亿元 -12.0%. Sums to the total; useful for a sector-sum route but shares the NBS source.
Jan-Sep 2025 base: 53,732.0亿元, +3.2% cumulative, September 2025 single month +21.6%. Consistent across sources; this is the base for yoy scaling.
Jan-Aug 2025 base: 46,929.7亿元 +0.9%, revenue 89.62万亿元 +2.3%, margin 5.24%. Consistent with the Jan-Sep 2025 release; used for partial-period and margin routes.
Cumulative yoy growth path 2026: 18.7% (Jan-Jun), 17.6% (Jan-Jul), 15.7% (Jan-Aug). Shows deceleration; Trading Economics 'September' row is only the prior value, not a forecast.
Jan-Sep 2026 industrial value-added +5.3% cumulative, September +5.5%; sector VA growth mining 2.0%, manufacturing 5.7%, utilities 5.4%. Real-activity input for a nominal-output scaling route.
PPI trajectory: August +3.8% yoy (+0.4% mom), September +5.0% yoy (+1.2% mom). Positive PPI supports nominal revenue and profit in September; consistent with the reported margin improvement.
Jan-Sep 2024 base: 52,281.6亿元 -3.5%, September 2024 single month -27.1% (low base). Explains the strong September 2025 print and warns that September 2026 faces a high base.
Jan-Sep 2025 sector split: mining 6,369.2亿元 -29.3%, manufacturing 40,671.8亿元 +9.9%, utilities 6,691.0亿元 +10.3%. Base for sector-level yoy scaling.
Jan-Sep 2025 revenue 102.08万亿元 +2.4%, margin 5.26%; September 2025 single-month margin 5.49% and revenue +2.7%. Base for margin/revenue route.

Threshold definitions conflict: Trading Economics says 5 million CNY annual sales; NBS says 20 million CNY main business revenue. The NBS definition (p287) is authoritative; p140 is a stale/incorrect secondary description.
Jan-May 2026 brokerage summary: profit +18.8%, margin 5.56%, revenue +5.5%, PPI +1.0%. Consistent with the decelerating path to 15.7% by August; useful context but not a September input.

Jan-Apr 2026: profit ~2.4万亿元 +18%, margin 5.4%, revenue +5%. Consistent with the early-2026 acceleration; sector margins (electronics, non-ferrous, chemicals) explain the mining/manufacturing profit surge.
September 2026 activity: capacity utilisation 73.1%, IP +5.5%, PMI 50.1, sales rate 97.0%, export delivery value +10.7% cumulative. Supports continued but moderating nominal growth.

MOF SOE profits: Jan-Jul 2026 25,089.9亿元 +0.6%, Jan-Jun 22,475.8亿元 +2.4%; 2025 comparators. Different population (all SOEs incl. non-industrial) so only a weak directional cross-check, not a direct bridge.

methods.label: m1
methods.rationale: Seasonal-increment route: Jan-Sep 2026 = Jan-Aug 2026 (52,719.8亿元) scaled by the 2025 ratio of Jan-Sep to Jan-Aug (53,732.0 / 46,929.7 = 1.145). p168 is in CNY and p131 in 亿元; code aligns units. Assumes the September seasonal increment as a share of the Jan-Aug cumulative is stable across years. Failure mode: the 2025 September increment was unusually large (21.6% single-month growth), so this may
methods.error: partial_period: an earlier partial value (4.69297e+12) is larger than its full period (53,732), so it is not a part of it

methods.label: m3

a1.role: September 2026 single-month profit growth vs September 2025

methods.rationale: Decomposes the target into the observed Jan-Aug 2026 level plus a September 2026 single-month increment. The September 2025 single-month level is backed out as p131 - p168/1e8 (converting CNY to 亿元), and its growth to 2026 is a1. Failure mode: a1 is uncertain and the September 2025 base is high.
methods.error: formula: numeric constant 100000000 not allowed (only 1 and exponents); make it a named input. If the number only converts units (1000 g per kg, days per year), drop it and set the method's "unit" to the unit the formula then gives (e.g. 'g/day'); code converts it to 'CNY'

methods.label: m5

a3.role: September 2026 single-month profit as a share of the Jan-Aug 2026 cumulative

methods.rationale: Base-rate route: Jan-Sep 2026 = Jan-Aug 2026 (52,719.8亿元) times (1 + September share of Jan-Aug). The 2025 September share was 14.5%; the high 2025 base argues for a lower 2026 share, central 10%. Failure mode: September 2026 profit is unusually weak or strong relative to the seasonal norm.

combination.weight_gate: off: inverse backtest-error weights need a bank-level gate (>= 30 scored questions with >= 2 backtested routes, hit rate >= 0.7; METHODS_ZH 4.1), which has not been run

m3.note: Monte Carlo width below the default, not used to narrow

interval.rule: one block, so the interval is that block's own width

excluded_by_input_audit.label: m4
excluded_by_input_audit.reason: input audit: p4: Evidence is a revenue level (93.09 trillion CNY for Jan-Aug 2026), not a growth rate; the role requires a growth rate to apply as (1 + p4).

kept.name: September 2026 single-month profit growth vs September 2025
kept.rationale: September 2025 single-month profit grew 21.6% (p355), a high base that mechanically suppresses September 2026 yoy growth. August 2026 single-month growth was 4.2% (p3), July 11.2% (p342); PPI reflation (p351, p378) supports nominal revenue, but the base effect dominates. Central 6% with a wide range

kept.falsified_by: A September 2026 single-month print outside 0.5% to 20%, or evidence that the September 2025 base was revised materially.

kept.name: Jan-Sep 2026 cumulative profit margin
kept.rationale: Jan-Aug 2026 cumulative margin was 5.66% (p5), flat vs Jan-Jul. August single-month margin was 5.67% (p349) and rising seasonally; September typically sees margin recovery. PPI positive supports margin. Central 5.7% with modest range around the observed 5.66%.

kept.falsified_by: A reported Jan-Sep 2026 margin below 5.4% or above 6.0%.

kept.name: September 2026 single-month profit as a share of the Jan-Aug 2026 cumulative
kept.rationale: In 2025, September single-month profit = Jan-Sep minus Jan-Aug = 53,732.0 - 46,929.7 = 6,802.3亿元, which is 14.5% of the Jan-Aug 2025 total. September 2026 faces a high base, so the share should be below the 2025 14.5%; central 10% with range 6-15%.

The estimate rests on the observed Jan–Aug 2026 cumulative of 52,720 亿元 (100 million CNY) and assumption a3, that September 2026 single-month profit equals 0.1 of the Jan–Aug cumulative (range 0.06 to 0.15). The 2025 September share was unusually high, so a lower share is assumed. Only one method block survived, so it carries full weight; the interval is conditional on a3, not a demonstrated accuracy guarantee.

The main risk is that September 2026 profit is unusually weak or strong relative to the seasonal norm. Better evidence would be a September 2026 single-month figure or a reliable seasonal pattern across years.
